_doc: The 4Pi-SIMFLUX data set: where the raw dcimg files are (root: used unless the config key data4pi / env SIMCODE_4PI_DATA is set; the globs are relative to it), how one camera frame is cut into the four interference channels (layout: crop windows of cw x ch px at the raw columns x0, mirror = channels flipped left-right so that all four overlay), camera and pixel constants, and per cell the per-angle 4Pi phase offset delta (deg; SMLM_REPORT 5.2). Read through simcode/fourpi/setup.py.
